title: Campania Pays Less at the Pump — But the Discount Is Shrinking
dek: Self-service Benzina and Gasolio in Campania both undercut today's national self-service average, even after a week-long rebound off their August 11 lows.
body: Today in Campania, self-service Benzina runs €1.995/L and self-service Gasolio €2.114/L — both a touch below the national self-service averages of €2.002/L and €2.118/L. That works out to roughly seven-tenths of a cent less than the rest of Italy for petrol and about four-tenths of a cent less for diesel, a modest but consistent local discount.

The past week tells a small rebound story: Campania's Benzina slid to a seven-day low of €1.989/L on August 11 before climbing back to today's €1.995/L, and Gasolio traced the same dip-and-recovery, bottoming at €2.104/L on the same day and rising to €2.114/L since. Of the region's 2,116 registered stations, 1,844 reported prices today — an 87% reporting rate, a shade below the national 90%, but still a healthy, active sample to trust the trend.

Numbers like these — tracked to the tenth of a cent, refreshed for a different region every single day — would be brutal to maintain by hand in a spreadsheet.
